description: Work out the no-vig (margin-free) fair price for a two- or three-way market. Method: for each bookmaker that prices every outcome at the same line, convert prices to implied chances (1 / decimal price), divide by their total so they add to 100% (the proportional method), then average those chances across bookmakers and convert back (1 / chance). Also reports each bookmaker's margin and the combined margin of the best prices. Use event_id and market for live prices, or pass prices to calculate by hand with no API call. The result estimates the chance; it is not a prediction or a tip.

line.description: Line to use: the home team's handicap for a line market, the total for a total market

prices.description: Calculate by hand from these decimal prices instead of calling the API

books.description: Each bookmaker's decimal prices in the same order as outcomes
